categories.main_business_segments: Shouyao Holdings is primarily engaged in innovative drug research and development, focusing on small molecule anti-tumor drugs. The company develops drugs targeting various cancers including non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), thyroid cancer, pancreatic cancer, and hematologic malignancies. It also undertakes cooperative drug development projects with other pharmaceutical companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced AI-driven drug design, target biology, pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, toxicology, and clinical research platforms. It uses computer-aided drug design, molecular optimization, and comprehensive screening technologies. Manufacturing is outsourced to contract manufacturing organizations (CMO/CDMO) under the Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) system, with quality management aligned to regulatory standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include pharmaceutical companies engaged in cooperative drug development and clinical research institutions. The end markets are primarily oncology patients in China, focusing on unmet medical needs in cancers such as ALK-positive NSCLC, RET fusion-positive NSCLC, and other solid tumors. The company also targets global markets through international clinical trial collaborations and academic exchanges.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and research facilities in Beijing. Clinical trials are conducted across nearly 100 centers nationwide. It also participates in international academic conferences and multi-center clinical trials, enhancing its global presence in oncology drug development.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shouyao Holdings operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug discovery, preclinical research, and clinical development. Manufacturing is outsourced, and the company plans to build its own industrialization base for future production. It does not engage in downstream commercial sales currently but plans to establish a sales team and collaborate with contract sales organizations for market penetration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovative drug development with a focus on first-in-class and best-in-class small molecule targeted therapies for oncology. It emphasizes AI-enabled drug design, multi-target inhibition strategies, and combination therapies to overcome resistance. Expansion into large molecule drug platforms and continuous pipeline enrichment in oncology and other therapeutic areas like autoimmune and metabolic diseases are strategic R&D directions.
categories.revenue_model: Currently, revenue is generated mainly from milestone payments and cooperative research and development service fees. The company has no commercial drug sales revenue yet as its core products are in clinical or regulatory review stages. Future revenue is expected from product sales post-approval, licensing, and potential profit-sharing from cooperative projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shouyao Holdings is positioned as a leading innovative drug R&D company in China, especially in small molecule oncology drugs. It is the first domestic company to cover second, third, and fourth-generation ALK inhibitors and has competitive products in RET and KRAS (G12C) inhibitors. Competitors include multinational pharmaceutical companies and domestic biotech firms developing similar targeted therapies. The company leverages its broad pipeline and clinical trial progress to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the company has total assets of approximately RMB 922 million and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 810 million. It has no interest-bearing debt and holds cash and liquid financial assets totaling around RMB 868 million. The company is not yet profitable, with a net loss of approximately RMB 212 million in 2024, reflecting ongoing heavy R&D investment. R&D expenses have steadily increased, representing over 5,000% of revenue due to limited current sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shouyao Holdings emphasizes its differentiated and innovative drug pipeline targeting high unmet medical needs in oncology, with proprietary small molecule drugs exhibiting superior efficacy and safety profiles. It integrates AI technology for efficient drug design and has established a comprehensive R&D platform covering the entire drug development process. The company aims to provide affordable, high-quality innovative drugs to Chinese patients, reducing dependence on imported medicines and advancing precision medicine.
